segments.contextAfter: `registrationHandler`: A block called as errors arise or upon completion. The block’s `errors` parameter contains an array of [`CFError`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/CoreFoundation/CFError) references; an empty array indicates no errors. Each error reference contains a [`CFArray`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/CoreFoundation/CFArray) of font asset names corresponding to [`kCTFontManagerErrorFontAssetNameKey`](kctfontmanagererrorfontassetnamekey.md). These represent the font asset names causing the error and failing to register successfully. This block may be called multiple times during the registration process. The `done` parameter becomes [`true`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/true) when the registration process completes. Return [`false`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/false) from the block to stop the registration operation, like after receiving an error.
